column3: Solid oak vinyl record storage cabinet with turntable shelf – natural, 175 cm
column4: Your vinyl collection deserves more than just a shelf. This solid oak vinyl storage cabinet was designed with a living room in mind—a space where music has its own permanent place, visible, accessible, and thoughtfully designed to match the rest of your interior. The oak frame and wide solid wood top provide a rock-solid foundation for your entire audio setup. Your turntable and amplifier can stand side by side without unnecessary stacking. The open shelves on both sides let you store your records the safest way—upright, spines facing out, ready to discover at a glance. This cabinet treats your music collection as a beautiful part of your décor, not something to hide away. Inside this vinyl record cabinet sits an additional compartment behind the fluted wooden front—a subtle detail that softens the open construction's severity. Used to its full capacity, the cabinet holds around 210 records—making it genuine storage for a growing collection. Every piece is handcrafted in our workshop from raw solid wood using traditional joinery methods passed down for generations. We take no shortcuts with joints or finishing—this is why the cabinet ages with character rather than losing its charm with time. The middle compartment front can be made as an open, slatted version if you prefer a lighter, more breathable look. We can also provide a drawer variant instead of the hinged compartment. Interior dimensions and layout adjust to your specific space, collection, and equipment.
